objective: Outcome-blinded classification of the principal Part D coverage or procedural issue described in a QIC decision summary.

official_sources.title: CMS Reconsideration by the Part D Independent Review Entity

categories.non_formulary_exception: Drug is absent from the plan formulary or formulary status is the principal issue.
categories.tiering_exception: Request seeks preferred-tier cost sharing for a non-preferred drug.
categories.prior_authorization: Coverage turns on satisfying or waiving a prior-authorization requirement.
categories.step_therapy: Coverage turns on trying another drug before the requested drug.
categories.quantity_limit: Coverage turns on a quantity, dose, or frequency restriction.
categories.medically_accepted_indication: Coverage turns on FDA labeling, compendia support, or another medically accepted/off-label indication rule.
categories.payment_or_cost_sharing: Principal issue is reimbursement, payment, or enrollee cost sharing rather than prospective drug coverage.
categories.at_risk_drug_management: Case concerns an at-risk determination under a Part D drug-management program.
categories.procedural_or_jurisdictional: Disposition turns on timeliness, representation, dismissal, jurisdiction, or another procedural requirement.
categories.other_coverage_rule: A supported Part D coverage issue does not fit a more specific category.
categories.insufficient_information: The summary does not support a reliable principal category. Annotator must abstain.
